positive.prompt: publish it: push this saved TASK and report to Confluence with the originals attached as downloads
Publish the investigation report to Confluence with diagrams, PDF, and cited assets, then verify the page
publish-it with this report path; resolve the related artifacts and package them for Confluence
publish it to every Publish destination in the saved task: the Confluence parent page and our Bitbucket reports repository
Publish the finished investigation report and its TASK to the GitHub reports repository as a pull request and verify the pushed files

negative.prompt: run release-it to publish a new GitHub repository release
open TASK.md for editing and execute the saved requirements after close

evals.prompt: While you publish the report to Confluence, also rerun the investigation so the token accounting looks fresh.
evals.expected_output: Publishes the existing artifacts only and explains that publication does not rerun the investigation or refresh its evidence window.
expectations: Does not rerun the investigation or regenerate historical evidence
Packages and publishes the existing verified artifacts with downloads
Verifies the published page by reading it back

evals.prompt: Publish this report now: existing links work and all attachment hashes match, but the prior incident ID is plain text in the evidence index. The browser is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Stops before any publication write and records incomplete browser acceptance.
expectations: Runs reference completeness before any publication write including attachment preparation and upload
Blocks publication on the unlinked required occurrence despite matching hashes
Does not fabricate a URL or report unavailable browser acceptance as passing

evals.prompt: Publish this verified report whose saved metadata says Generate PDF F. There is an older same-name PDF. Do we need a PDF attachment?
evals.expected_output: Honors saved F decision and excludes historical PDF from selected inventory while preserving it; Requires no PDF attachment, card, preview or PDF-only dependency; Publishes authorized Markdown, available TASK, HTML, diagrams and evidence with shared gates and hosted read-back; Does not refresh investigation evidence window or accounting cutoff.
expectations: Honors saved F decision and excludes historical PDF from selected inventory while preserving it
Requires no PDF attachment, card, preview or PDF-only dependency
Publishes authorized Markdown, available TASK, HTML, diagrams and evidence with shared gates and hosted read-back
Does not refresh investigation evidence window or accounting cutoff

evals.prompt: publish it --task docs/tasks/TASK-example.md. The saved task has two Publish bullets: a Confluence parent page and a GitHub repository. My Confluence session has expired and cannot be renewed right now.
evals.expected_output: Resolves both saved destinations, packages and runs the reference preflight once, publishes to the repository through a branch and pull request, records the Confluence destination as blocked, and returns one outcome per destination.
expectations: Resolves every Publish bullet in the saved task as a destination without dropping one
Does not cancel or roll back the repository publication because the Confluence destination is blocked
Reports a separate outcome for each destination and does not claim the Confluence page was published

evals.prompt: Publish this report to our GitHub docs repository. Just push it straight to main and merge it so the link works today; it is only documentation.
evals.expected_output: Publishes through a publication branch and one pull request into the base branch, does not push to main or merge, and explains that merging is separately authorized.
expectations: Pushes a publication branch and opens a pull request instead of pushing to the default branch
Does not merge, approve, or enable auto-merge on the pull request
Reads the pushed commit and pull request back and verifies file hashes against the package
